design_system.theme_rules: No shadows, no backdrop-blur, no heavy gradients, no popup animations, instant visual feedback, high contrast

typography.rules: Large Rupiah amounts in bold monospace. Headings in Plus Jakarta Sans. Explicit text hierarchy.

tailwind_classes.card: bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3 sm:p-4 hover:border-emerald-600 active:bg-slate-50
tailwind_classes.button_primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg border border-emerald-700 active:scale-[0.99] text-base cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50
tailwind_classes.button_secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 active:scale-[0.99] text-base cursor-pointer
tailwind_classes.button_danger: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg border border-red-700 text-base cursor-pointer
tailwind_classes.input: bg-white border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-slate-900 focus:border-emerald-600 focus:outline-none text-base w-full
tailwind_classes.badge_stock_low: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded
tailwind_classes.badge_stock_ok: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded
tailwind_classes.numpad_btn: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 text-xl font-bold rounded-lg border-2 border-slate-300 active:bg-emerald-600 active:text-white h-14 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer

pos_tablet_split.left_catalog_width: w-full lg:w-[62%] h-full flex flex-col border-r-2 border-slate-300 bg-slate-50
pos_tablet_split.right_cart_width: hidden lg:flex lg:w-[38%] h-full flex-col bg-white
pos_tablet_split.catalog_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-3 p-3 overflow-y-auto

pos_mobile_view.floating_cart_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 lg:hidden bg-emerald-800 text-white p-3 border-t-2 border-emerald-900 flex justify-between items-center z-40
pos_mobile_view.bottom_sheet_cart: fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 top-12 z-50 bg-white border-t-4 border-emerald-600 flex flex-col

layout_architecture.numpad_modal: fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4

general_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='pos-catalog-search-input', data-testid='cart-item-increment-btn').
general_guidelines.performance: No transition-all, no backdrop-blur, no shadow effects. Instant state updates and offline resilience.
general_guidelines.currency_format: Always format numbers as Rp XX.XXX using locale ID ('id-ID').
